confidence_notes: Havana-specific food and drink aggregates are recent but reflect a small contributor pool amid severe price and currency volatility. The cocktail estimate uses the reported local mojito range; wine by the glass is estimated at about twice the draft-beer price because direct restaurant glass data were unavailable. Accommodation anchors are broad holistic estimates with especially high uncertainty; no live lodging prices were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Havana-specific cost-of-living aggregates. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on broad Cuban and Caribbean visitor-market expectations; no single comparable city was used.
